fields.Detail:
Cancer care close to the Westbank

West Jefferson Medical Center offers a comprehensive cancer program for patients who want treatment without leaving Jefferson Parish. The dedicated cancer buildings on Westbank Expressway include infusion, radiation therapy — the only radiation therapy department on the Westbank — and a setting designed for longer visits, with reclining chairs, Wi-Fi, and nourishment stations for patients and caregivers.

The program includes palliative care, survivorship planning, and access to clinical trials. Technology available to the team includes PET/CT, digital mammography, and robotic surgery with the da Vinci system when it is the right approach.

Where to go

  • Cancer Center: 4513 Westbank Expy., Marrero, LA 70072
  • Infusion: 4511 Westbank Expy., Marrero, LA 70072
  • Phone: 504-349-6360

Call the cancer care team to schedule a visit or a second-opinion conversation. Find oncologists through Find a Provider.

fields.Detail:
Gastroenterology for everyday gut health

When meals lead to pain, reflux, bloating, or ongoing stomach trouble, digestive specialists at West Jefferson Medical Center can evaluate the esophagus, stomach, liver, pancreas, gallbladder, and intestines.

The hospital operates a stand-alone endoscopy center with dedicated parking, six procedure rooms, and private recovery rooms so colonoscopy and endoscopy visits are easier for patients and families. Call 504-349-6401 or the hospital at 504-347-5511 to discuss a referral.

fields.Detail:
Otolaryngology on the Westbank

The Department of Otolaryngology — Head and Neck Surgery at West Jefferson Medical Center cares for ear, nose, and throat conditions across the lifespan. Patients come here for recurring infections, nasal blockage, voice and swallowing problems, sleep apnea, facial injury, and thyroid or parathyroid disease.

Whether the need is an acute illness, a chronic sinus condition, or evaluation of a neck mass, the ENT team works to diagnose the cause and match treatment to each patient’s goals — from medical management to in-office procedures and surgery when it is the better option.

How to make an appointment

Call the West Jefferson ENT clinic at 504-934-8550 to schedule, or find an otolaryngologist in the LCMC Health provider directory.

West Jefferson Medical Center Ear, Nose & Throat
1111 Medical Center Blvd., Suite N-707
Marrero, LA 70072
Phone: 504-934-8550

Conditions we treat

Common reasons patients are referred to ENT at West Jefferson include:

  • Recurring ear infections, hearing loss, tinnitus, and balance concerns
  • Chronic sinusitis, nasal polyps, allergic rhinitis, and nasal obstruction
  • Tonsillitis, snoring, obstructive sleep apnea, and voice or swallowing difficulty
  • Thyroid nodules and tumors, parathyroid disease, and neck masses
  • Facial injury and selected cosmetic or reconstructive needs of the face and eyelids

Treatments and procedures

Care plans start with a focused exam and, when needed, in-office endoscopy or imaging. Medical therapy is used whenever it can control symptoms. When procedures are appropriate, the team offers a range of ear, nose, throat, and neck operations, including:

Ear

Evaluation and treatment for infection, hearing, and related ear conditions, coordinated with audiology when testing is part of the workup.

Nose

Medical and surgical options for sinus disease, polyps, and nasal obstruction, aimed at restoring breathing and reducing repeat infections.

Throat

Care for tonsil and adenoid disease, snoring and sleep apnea, and voice or swallowing disorders, including procedures when conservative care is not enough.

Neck and face

  • Thyroidectomy and parathyroidectomy
  • Neck dissection and thyroglossal duct excision
  • Hyoid suspension for selected sleep-related airway problems
  • Blepharoplasty and therapeutic Botox when clinically indicated

What to expect

Bring a list of medications, prior imaging or sleep studies, and questions about recovery time. If surgery is recommended, your surgeon will review benefits, risks, and after-care before you decide. For hospital campus parking and visitor hours, see Patients & Visitors.

fields.Detail:
When every minute matters

The West Jefferson Medical Center Emergency Department is open 24 hours a day for serious illness and injury. Board-certified emergency physicians treat children, adults, and seniors, including dedicated spaces that support geriatric emergency care.

Fast Track is available 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily for lower-acuity needs. During a visit, patients can receive real-time updates on their phone so they know what comes next in the ER.

Address: 1101 Medical Center Blvd., Marrero, LA 70072
Main hospital: 504-347-5511
For life-threatening emergencies, call 911.

fields.Detail:
Hyperbaric oxygen therapy

Hyperbaric medicine at West Jefferson Medical Center supports patients whose wounds or other conditions may improve with high-concentration oxygen in a controlled chamber setting. The service is often coordinated with wound care so patients have a single hospital team managing dressing, infection control, and oxygen therapy.

Your physician determines whether hyperbaric treatment is appropriate. To discuss a referral, call the hospital at 504-347-5511 or ask your wound care provider.

fields.Detail:
Diagnostic imaging across the campus

West Jefferson Medical Center Imaging serves inpatients, emergency patients, and outpatients in the hospital, the Physician’s Office Building, and the Medical Plaza on Westbank Expressway. Inpatient and ER imaging run 24/7. Outpatient centers offer MRI/MRA, 3T MRI, ultrasound, 3D mammography, CT, DEXA, and X-ray in a filmless PACS environment.

Women’s Imaging and Breast Care Center: 4521 Westbank Expressway, Marrero — 504-349-6300. Physician Office Building imaging: 1111 Medical Center Blvd., Suite N-108 — 504-349-6191.

Ask your physician to order imaging, or call the numbers above to schedule an outpatient exam.

Keeping Westbank patients moving

Orthopedic care at West Jefferson Medical Center covers injuries and chronic conditions of bones, joints, and related tissues. Teams typically begin with immobilization, medication, and physical therapy. When those approaches no longer control pain or restore daily activity, orthopedic surgeons discuss surgical options using current techniques.

Rehabilitation can continue on campus through physical rehabilitation services. Hospital main number: 504-347-5511. Find an orthopedic specialist.

fields.Detail:
Rehabilitation after illness or injury

West Jefferson Medical Center provides a comprehensive rehabilitation program certified by CARF. Patients may receive inpatient rehab, outpatient physical and occupational therapy, and cardiac rehabilitation. Companies on the Westbank can also use the on-campus Return to Work Center.

Your care team helps set goals for strength, mobility, and returning to home or work. Call 504-347-5511 to reach rehabilitation services, or ask your physician for a referral.

Better rest, better health

Sleep disorders affect daytime energy, heart health, and safety. West Jefferson Medical Center sleep care evaluates snoring, obstructive sleep apnea, and related conditions. Treatment may include lifestyle guidance, devices, or procedures coordinated with ENT or pulmonary specialists.

Ask your primary care physician for a referral, or call 504-347-5511. ENT patients with sleep apnea concerns can also start on the ENT page.

fields.Detail:
Fast stroke response

West Jefferson Medical Center is designated a Comprehensive Stroke Center by The Joint Commission. Emergency teams, neuroscience specialists, and rehabilitation staff work together from first symptoms through recovery.

If you suspect a stroke, call 911. Do not drive yourself. For non-emergency questions about stroke services, call the hospital at 504-347-5511. Learn more about the LCMC Health Neuroscience Institute.

Surgical care in Marrero

West Jefferson Medical Center surgeons offer general surgery and subspecialty care including colorectal, thyroid, breast, laparoscopic, robotic, bariatric, and oncologic surgery. The team is known regionally for hernia repair and for teaching other surgeons to use the da Vinci robot for minimally invasive procedures.

Before surgery you will review benefits, risks, and recovery with your surgeon. Scheduling: 504-349-6713. Hospital: 504-347-5511. Find a surgeon.

Specialized wound healing

Chronic wounds related to diabetes, circulation problems, or surgery need a dedicated plan. West Jefferson Medical Center wound care teams assess the wound, manage infection risk, and coordinate dressings, offloading, and, when appropriate, hyperbaric oxygen therapy.

Ask your physician for a referral or call the hospital at 504-347-5511. Bring a list of medications and prior wound treatments to the first visit.
